mapper.select: select dmmc as sf, zymc as zy, count(*) as firstZyEnrollNum from t_zyzy left join t_zydm on t_zydm.zydh = t_zyzy.zydh and year = '2021' left join t_ksxx on t_zyzy.ksh = t_ksxx.ksh left join td_zdb on t_ksxx.sfdm = dm and dmlb = 'sfdm' and yxx = 1 where t_zyzy.zyxh = '1' group by sfdm, zymc
